remarks: Welcome to 940 E 3rd St, ideally situated in the heart of Long Beach and offering the perfect blend of space, comfort, and coastal city living. This inviting residence features a bright, open layout with updated flooring, recessed lighting, and generous living and dining areas designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The updated kitchen offers crisp white cabinetry, ample counter space, subway tile backsplash, stainless steel appliances, and abundant storage. Spacious bedrooms provide plenty of flexibility for sleeping, working from home, or creating a relaxing retreat.
